title: SMOK Pineapple Nic Salt E-Liquid 20mg
description: Designed for use with the Elf Bar Mate 500 pod kit, these pre-filled pods contain 2ml of nicotine salt e-liquid. Combined with the Elf Bar Mate 500 rechargeable pod kit, these pods help reduce waste while still delivering the amazing flavour and effortless convenience of a fully-disposable Elf Bar kit. There’s no need to refill the Elf Bar P1 disposable pod. Simply remove the pod from its air-sealed container, push the red seal at the base of the pod upwards , then insert the whole pod into the top of the Elf Bar Mate 500 battery component. With no buttons to press, settings to adjust, tanks to refill, or coils to swap, you can start vaping delicious flavour immediately. And when your pod runs low on e-liquid, simply dispose of the pod and replace with a new one. This pack of 2 x Elf Bar P1 pod comes pre-filled with Blue Razz flavour nicotine salt e-liquid, a delicious Lemonade flavour that blends rich, sweet Blueberries and sharp, tangy Raspberries.
